remarks: Nestled in the sought-after Birchwood complex, this spacious three-bedroom, two-bath condo offers comfort and convenience.This one-level living unit features beautiful hardwood floors and a desirable open floor plan.The welcoming foyer leads to a living room with a wood-burning fireplace, seamlessly flowing into the dining area and private balcony, perfect for relaxing or entertaining.The generously sized bedrooms offer ample closet space, while the primary suite includes an en-suite bath.Recent updates include new hardwood flooring, fresh paint, and a new dishwasher.The A/C and heating systems have also been recently updated.Enjoy resort-style amenities, including a pool and club house.Additional highlights include an attached one-car garage and a private storage area with interior access.This cul-de-sac location offers tranquility while being minutes from downtown Westport and Route 1, beaches, Metro-North, highways, restaurants, and shopping.Westport mailing address but Norwalk schools and taxes.Don't miss this prime opportunity on the Westport/Norwalk border!
